name: gap-web-search-disabled
about: tools.webSearch 缺省（没有这一段）与 enabled=false、以及 enabled 但缺 apiKey / endpoint 时（webSearch.ts:236-260 checkWebSearchAvailability）：工具清单里有没有 web_search；模型硬调时的错误。这里是 enabled 但 custom 缺 endpoint 与 apiKey。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
tools:
  webSearch:
    enabled: true
    provider: custom
